name: Momotsuka Takuma
source:
A second-year middle school student who comes from an extremely ordinary household. When he participates in a historical studies extracurricular activities camp and visits a shrine with a legend of mysterious disappearances, he suddenly finds himself lost in another world.

His digimon partner is Agumon.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2018/09/digimon-survive-details-story-takuma-and-agumon-aoi-and-labramon-and-minoru-and-falcomon]Gematsu's translation[/url]]
